thread:
Sam: quick heads-up — console observability roadmap sync. hitting two milestones this sprint: dashboard baseline and tracing hook rollout. tagging owners so we can clear deps.
Riley: thanks. can you call out what "baseline" means here? is it just signal surface or UI polish too?
Sam: baseline = dashboards with: error-rate, p50/p95 latency per-route, and a rolling anomalies panel. not UI polish — minimal but usable.
Priya: tracing hooks question: do we need infra changes to include the new trace headers (x-rw-span, x-rw-sample)? Mateo, infra-bot flagged a sampling flag behind a feature flag.
Mateo: yeah infra needs a small flag flip + config API change. I can flip for staging tomorrow if product sign-off. ETA 24h after sign-off.
Riley: ok thanks. Dana / product: can you confirm sign-off for staging rollout tomorrow?
Dana: confirmed — staging sign-off provided for the baseline signals. please keep the UI minimal. :white_check_mark:
Priya: perfect. two follow-ups: 1) retention plan — do we default to 30d for traces and 90d for dashboards events? 2) any legal/ops constraints?
Sam: proposal in doc (link): /policies/obs-retention.md — default 30d traces, 90d aggregated metrics; archived exports for >90d. legal flagged nothing new but we should keep audit logs for 1yr.
Mateo: infra note — 30d traces at current sampling is fine on staging, but prod needs reducer/aggregation first or cost jumps. I'll share a cost estimate by EOD.
Riley: PR ping — I left comments on the dashboard config PR (riley/dashboard-config#34). one open item: can we make alert thresholds configurable per-team?
Priya: yes, alerts per-team is a req. I added a schema snippet in the PR:
```
alerts:
  - name: high-error-rate
    scope: team
    threshold: 0.05
```
Sam: action items: Mateo to post infra cost estimate (EOD), Priya to merge tracing hook PR once infra flag is ready, Riley to resolve dashboard config comments, Dana to confirm legal/audit retention mapping. I'll run a short smoke test plan once staging is up.
Mateo: noted, will post estimate and flip staging flag after Dana confirms.
infra-bot: deploy-staging triggered by Mateo at 2026-03-17T15:42Z — status: queued.
Dana: good cadence. if smoke looks ok we can greenlight canary next week. :rocket: 
Sam: thanks all — will post a short checklist and follow-ups later today.
Riley: acked.
Priya: thanks!
